reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "0.86.0 / 2025-10-07: [!NOTE] This release introduces the status subresource (behind the `StatusForConfigurationResources` feature gate) for `ServiceMonitor`…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Configuration resources (ServiceMonitor, PodMonitor, ScrapeConfig, PrometheusRule, Probe) now have an optional status subresource when the StatusForConfigurationResources feature gate is enabled; existing manifests without status fields continue to work.

proposed.statement: The status subresource is added to ServiceMonitor, PodMonitor, ScrapeConfig, PrometheusRule, and Probe custom resources, controlled by the StatusForConfigurationResources feature gate.
